name: mondo-functions
description: Mondo Cloud Functions — the server side that holds the answer.

scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions,firestore,auth
scripts.test:rules: tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && npx --yes firebase-tools@latest emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-mondo --config ../firebase.json "node --test .test-build/test/rules/*.test.js"
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && npx --yes firebase-tools@latest emulators:exec --only functions,firestore,auth,pubsub --project demo-mondo --config ../firebase.json "node --test .test-build/test/e2e/phase2.e2e.js .test-build/test/e2e/phase3.e2e.js"
